<!--
Single source of truth for issue title/body structure.
CLAUDE.md references this file; do not duplicate the structure there.
-->

<!--
Keep only the sections relevant to the issue; remove any that do not apply.
-->

## Overview

<!--
What the problem or need is, why it matters, and what the goal is.
Include relevant background and current behavior when useful.
-->

## Approach

<!--
How to address the problem — implementation plan or strategy, not a list of diffs.
If multiple approaches are described, document which one was chosen and why, either here or in an issue comment.
-->

## References

<!--
Related issues, pull requests, documentation, discussions, or prior decisions.
Prefer explicit relationship prefixes such as:
- Supersedes:
- Revisits:
- Follow-up to:
- Related to:
- Depends on:
-->

## Considerations

<!--
Known caveats, constraints, risks, compatibility concerns, or other things to keep in mind.
-->

## Definition of Done

<!--
Include only when merging the implementation is not sufficient to consider the issue complete.
-->
